proposal.summary: cm550_tableLookup2D (0x35088) is CM550's 2-D table interpolation. Each caller owns a 22-byte table_lookup_2d_arguments_t in RAM. An initializer fills it with the Calterm table pointers (x axis, y axis and z grid; each axis starts with a byte count word) and cached offsets of 2. Before each call the caller writes the x and y inputs at +6 and +0xe. The dumped ROM holds 27 references to 0x35088 (25 jsr (0x35088).l and 2 movea.l #0x35088,a5 for jsr (a5); there are no PC-relative calls), and they cover 19 records. Four are typed already; the other 15 are proposed here, each named from the e2m records of the tables its dumped pointers point at and from what the caller does with the result. Every absolute reference into each record is the lookup, its two input stores or its initializer, so the old automatic rows inside the records are removed. The duty cycle monitor axes are whole Calterm T records: DCMNESTB is word[10] (count 18 + 9 speeds) and DCMNLDTB is word[8] (count 14 + 7 loads), which confirms the lead's sizes. CM848 has the same two records at ROM 0x5c2c0 (word[10]) and 0x5c2d4 (word[12], 11 points), with no rows yet.

4) Function name leads (for a later function batch; not analysed for CM848 twins). cm550_fuelTimingTransitionStateMachine 0xc180 computes air_fuel_control_fuel_limit (the AFC table or the override value, plus the cold temperature increment); CM848 has cm848_calculateAirFuelControlFuelLimit. cm550_rpmHistogramAndProtectionStatisticsAccumulator 0xc66a computes altitude_derate_fuel_limit. cm550_coldStartFuelControlSlowCycle40Coordinator 0x11e5e is cylinder pressure maintenance. cm550_governorFuelModeBlendCalculator 0x178b0 computes the crank 4D timing (CK4DTA) and crank_exit_advance. cm550_fuelDemandTableBlendCalculator 0x1c65e computes the 4D injection timing. vp44_FUN_000127c2 / vp44_FUN_000133fe are cylinder balancing and its initializer; nothing in the code they touch is VP44. The record initializers are cm550_fuelTimingModeInit, cm550_fuelParameterPointerSetup, cm550_initLoadTrendingSystem, vp44_fuelLimitParameterPointerSetup (crank 4D timing + wet stack; not a VP44 or fuel limit function), cm550_FUN_0001c7a8, cm550_FUN_0001cdf8 and cm550_FUN_0001ddb4.

6) Judgment calls. I named the crank records after CM848's crank_four_dimensional_timing (CK4DTA) and the main timing records after CM848's four_dimensional_injection_timing (4DTBTA); CM848 calls the steady state / transient tables map_a / map_b, and I used the Calterm words instead. 0x8006ea is named for its use (the low horsepower or tau 0 curve at 100 percent throttle), because four records share its steady state table. I added the 6 cylinder balancing RAM tables and the 2 CM848 duty cycle axes because the same evidence proves them: e2m address, dump byte counts and adjacency, and the only code references.
